reconstructed_theorem_text:
Let E be a finite-dimensional real Hilbert space with its Borel measurable structure and canonical ordinary Lebesgue volume; dimension zero is permitted and all approved section instances belong to the contract. Let W:E->R be C2. Assume exp(-W) is volume-integrable and its volume integral is strictly positive. Let m be any real number and assume that for every x,a in E,
  m*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R W) x a) a.
There is no positivity or nonnegativity assumption on m. Let mu:Measure E be supplied with the exact law equality mu=volume.tilted(x->-W(x)), namely exp(-W)/integral exp(-W) times volume.
Let D:L2(mu;R)->L2(mu;E) be a real-linear partial operator on its actual submodule domain. Assume D is closable and has exactly the following graph: for every scalar L2 class a and vector L2 class H, (a,H) belongs to graph(D) iff there exists a smooth compactly supported real function psi with a=psi mu-almost everywhere and H=gradient(psi) mu-almost everywhere. The closure is the genuine operator obtained from that same graph closure.
Let v,F:E->R, G:E->E and K:Set E. Assume K compact and each of tsupport(v),tsupport(F),tsupport(G) is contained in K. Assume actual MemLp v 2 volume, MemLp F 2 volume and MemLp G 2 volume. For every real C1 compactly supported psi and every a:E, assume both x->psi(x)*<G(x),a>_E and x->v(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) are volume-integrable and
  integral psi(x)*<G(x),a>_E dx = - integral v(x)*(fderiv R psi x a) dx.
For every real C2 compactly supported psi, assume both x->v(x)*Delta(psi)(x) and x->F(x)*psi(x) are volume-integrable and
  integral v(x)*Delta(psi)(x) dx = integral F(x)*psi(x) dx.
Here gradient and fderiv are actual operators and Delta on tests is the actual finite-basis Laplacian; no classical gradient/Hessian of rough v or G is assumed.
Define the actual scalar function A(x)=<gradient(W)(x),G(x)>_E-F(x), with exactly this minus sign. Then v,G,A each satisfy actual MemLp at exponent 2 with respect to mu. Furthermore there exist actual scalar classes vW,AW in Lp R 2 mu and a vector class GW in Lp E 2 mu such that vW=v mu-almost everywhere, AW=A mu-almost everywhere and GW=G mu-almost everywhere, and simultaneously
  (vW,GW) belongs to D.closure.graph,
  m*||GW||_{L2(mu;E)}^2 <= ||AW||_{L2(mu;R)}^2.
Each MemLp includes actual a.e. strong measurability and finite L2 norm. The norms in the coercivity conclusion are genuine weighted quotient L2 norms. The supplied mu equality and original smooth-test graph are premises, whereas weighted L2, these returned quotient/AE links, same-operator closure membership, and the scalar inequality are outputs. No dense-domain premise or existence of D is added. This is a compact-supported ordinary weak-data to weighted-domain/coercivity result; it does not state a classical rough-function Laplacian, cutoff removal, global tail/global coercivity theorem, generator-adjoint/core equality, or further functional inequality/composition conclusion.
objects: C2 real potential W, positive finite partition integral, arbitrary real Hessian lower constant m; supplied normalized Gibbs measure mu; actual closable scalar-to-vector weighted L2 partial gradient D with exact smooth compact graph; rough pointwise real v,F and vector G with common compact support bound K and genuine ordinary-volume weak data; scalar A=<gradient W,G>-F; returned weighted scalar vW,AW/vector GW and same-original-operator closure graph/coercivity output.
domains: Finite-dimensional real Hilbert/Borel E with canonical volume, including zero dimension and approved section instances. W,v,F:E->R,G:E->E,m:R,mu:Measure E. Input L2 and all C1/C2 test L1 products/integrals use volume; D and output MemLp/norms/classes use supplied mu equal to exp(-W)/positive partition times volume. Scalar quotient classes are Lp R 2 mu, vector Lp E 2 mu, with actual selected measurable representatives. All graph AE identities are mu-AE.
quantifiers: Universal ambient E,W,m,mu,D,v,F,G,K satisfying all premises. Hessian lower bound forall x,a:E, with m any real. Original graph characterization forall scalar a/vector H and exists smooth compact real psi. Ordinary weak gradient forall real C1 compact psi and every a:E; weak Poisson forall real C2 compact psi. Let A, then three weighted MemLp outputs; exists scalar vW,AW then exists vector GW with all three AE links, closure graph membership and scalar norm inequality simultaneously. No target domain/inequality proof is a premise.
assumptions: W C2; actual volume Integrable exp(-W); strictly positive partition integral; m:R with forall x,a m*||a||^2 <= (fderiv R (fderiv R W) x a) a; supplied mu exact normalized tilt law; D.IsClosable and exact smooth compact function/gradient graph. K compact and each actual tsupport v/F/G subset K; MemLp v/F/G 2 volume. All C1 directional tests have both L1 products and signed weak-gradient equality; all C2 compact tests have both L1 products and weak-Poisson equality. m need not be nonnegative. No dense-domain hypothesis, rough classical derivative or weighted output-membership premise.
conclusion: With A=<gradient W,G>-F, actual MemLp v/G/A 2 mu. Exists true weighted quotient classes vW,AW,GW linked mu-AE to v,A,G respectively, with (vW,GW) in the original D.closure.graph and m*||GW||^2 <= ||AW||^2, using vector/scalar weighted L2 norms. Weighted class/domain/coercivity facts are produced together from ordinary compact weak data.
scopes: Supplied mu equality is structural, original D closable exact smooth compact graph is an input interface, and closure membership is an output for the rough AE-linked data. Same compact K bounds all three input supports, not equal supports. A uses precise minus F. Norm inequality permits any real m satisfying the lower bound. No approximation sequence, explicit Sobolev class, classical rough Hessian/Laplacian, global tail/cutoff removal, generator-adjoint/core equality or further functional inequality/composition is a stated conclusion.
constant_dependencies: m any real lower bound with no positivity constraint; L2/norm-square exponents exactly2. Gibbs density exp(-W)/Z with actual integrable strictly positive Z. A unit coefficients +1 on inner-gradient term and -1 on F; coercivity m*||GW||^2 <= ||AW||^2 with unit RHS. No unspecified constant, rate or support-radius bound. Output classes depend on W,m,mu,D and ordinary data/premises, not test choices.
